A poor experience.
Feb 2026 • Couples
I went along with my wife, and we ordered three vegetarian options, and one fish option. Everything was extremely disappointing.

None of the vegetarian stuff was tasty, or well prepared, and I got the impression that the quality of the ingredients and the quality of the presentation were low.
It’s important to say here that this restaurant charged a premium price, and that neither of us feel we got any kind of value for money. 

The fish (deep fried grouper with sweet and sour sauce) was just plain dull, and had nothing to recommend it whatsoever; the poor fish died in vain.

Finally, we were served old rice, and when we sent it back for some fresh rice, we received the old rice which had been heated up in a microwave.
Shameful; gives an idea of how the ownership view of the customers.

I’m afraid to say that my wife was unable to eat any of the vegetarian food, and we moved on elsewhere to get some decent stuff.

The waiting and the service was sound, uninspiring, and this trip to the restaurant will soon be forgotten. 

I would genuinely recommend to anyone who is considering going to this place to look elsewhere. I think it is beyond the ability of the people in charge of strategic and operational decisions to make this into anything better than what it is.

A real shame, this is something that we had been looking forward to
